contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. Independent primary check against SRC-0004 (Canning–Larson, arXiv:2208.02357v2) Lemma 10.6, retrieved from ar5iv HTML Section 10: deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f and deg(\omega_C\otimes W_f^\vee(\Gamma))=4f+n-2g-14. For balanced F=O(4)\oplus O(5) at (g,n)=(6,6) and f=5 this is 20+6-12-14=0. On a smooth connected curve a degree-zero line bundle N has H^0(N)\neq0 if and only if N≅O_C (a nonzero section is nowhere vanishing and trivializes N). Taking N=\omega_C\otimes W_5^\vee(\Gamma) yields H^0(N)\neq0 iff O_C(\Gamma)≅W_5\otimes\omega_C^{-1}=L, with deg(W_5)=16 and deg(L)=16-(2g-2)=6. Combined with corroborated FND-0062 (f=4 summand has degree -4 hence vanishes identically), the total Serre-dual obstruction H^0(\omega_C\otimes W^\vee(\Gamma))=H^0(f=4)\oplus H^0(f=5) is nonzero iff the f=5 summand is nonzero iff O_C(\Gamma)≅L. This is exactly the packet C66-GEO-Z six-point failure locus. Compatible with corroborated FND-0061: FND-0063 asserts the fibrewise degree-zero criterion for the f=5 obstruction component, not a complete scheme-theoretic identification of the CE failure locus as a relative Fitting/determinantal scheme (that obligation is FND-0046). Compatible with FND-0005 (RR nonemptiness of |L|): FND-0005 shows Z is nonempty; FND-0063 characterises the failure condition. Distinct from FND-0062 (f=4 vanishing), FND-0055 (vanishing on U is not a purity theorem), and FND-0052 (open vs closed embedding). Packet CE convention W_5:=(O(2)\otimes\gamma^*O(-5))|_C matches the degree calculation in Lemma 10.6 (which uses \gamma^*O(-f_i) even when the W_{f_i} indexing is notationally loose). Merge target: none. Promote from candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source on independent primary-source verification of the degree-zero arithmetic and the degree-zero triviality criterion.
